body:
# ItemSigner

Sign items just like signed books in Minecraft.

Create signed collectibles, certificates, contracts, rewards, currencies, and many other unique items with your Minecraft username.

![Signed Item Screenshot](https://cloud.endernation.net/index.php/s/zP2cXnwkWwyLzeP/preview)

---

## Commands

### `/sign`

Signs the item in your main hand.

The item receives a permanent signature containing your Minecraft username and cannot be signed again.

### `/sign all`

Signs all matching item stacks in your inventory.

The item in your main hand is used as the reference item. Only items of the same type will be signed.

Example:

* Hold a Coin Stack.
* Run `/sign all`.
* All Coin Stacks in your inventory are signed.
* Other items remain unchanged.

---

## Example

Before:

![Unsigned Item Screenshot](https://cloud.endernation.net/index.php/s/sN2JeMptBGN24gJ/preview)

After:

![Signed Item Screenshot](https://cloud.endernation.net/index.php/s/zP2cXnwkWwyLzeP/preview)

The signature is displayed directly in the item's lore:

```text
Signed by Steve
```

---

## Perfect For

* Currencies
* Collectibles
* Certificates
* Contracts
* Event Rewards
* Roleplay Servers
* Player Economies
